question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for the following phrase:
"A spot or a stain caused by a discoloring substance."
solution:
The correct answer is: **2 i.e. Blot**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Blot"** refers to a spot or stain caused by a discoloring substance. (धब्बा, दाग)
 
 
• **Example:** The ink left a blot on the paper after the pen leaked.
 
 
• It is commonly used to describe marks or spots that ruin the appearance of a surface.
